title: Dy thanks Marcos for directing VAT removal on system loss charge

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The removal of the 12-percent value-added tax on allowable system loss charges in electricity will provide direct relief to consumers, Speaker Faustino “Bojie” G. Dy III said in a statement on Monday thanking President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and concerned government agencies for acting quickly to bring down power costs. “Every peso we can remove from the electricity bill matters, especially to families already stretching their budgets for food, education, transportation, and other basic needs,” Dy said, shortly after the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) issued a circular removing the system loss VAT within the cap approved by the Energy […]...
